thread:
maria_sales: Quick handoff — Atlas Health (pilot starting tomorrow). 500-seat pilot, healthcare vertical, likely HIPAA scope. Sales committed to a dedicated capacity estimate for predictable latency; they want a path to private deployment within 3–6 months. Renewal window ~11 months. Primary asks: SSO (SAML), audit logs, throughput ~20k reqs/day with spikes to 5k/min. POC currently on Hosted API. Contract + SFDC link: https://sf.example.com/ATLAS-321

aj_cs: Thanks Maria — looping in Ravi to own CS. @ravi_csm please confirm runway and any immediate risks.

ravi_csm: Got it. I’ll take ownership. First pass: onboarding kickoff tomorrow 10am PT with their infra lead. Need SAML metadata, list of example prompts, and a contact who can approve data protection addendum. Tagging tasks below.

maria_sales: @ravi_csm contact is "lisa.kim@atlashealth.org" (security lead). I've attached the signed LOI in SFDC.

ravi_csm: Perfect. Action items I’ll start: 1) schedule kickoff + invite eng/support; 2) collect SAML metadata; 3) enable audit log retention to 1 year for pilot; 4) confirm Dedicated capacity config. Will update this thread with owners.

dena_support: Heads-up: SSO + private deploy will require a support ticket that eng needs to triage (networking + certs). Please create a ticket with attached SAML metadata and expected cutover window. Tag: private-onprem

tyler_eng: Re: dedicated capacity — need their expected sequence lengths and model choices. If they want long-context models (8k+), kernel selection changes. Also, KV-cache warmup on spikes can add latency — recommend warmup plan. Can we get sample traffic (CSV of timestamps + token lengths)?

maria_sales: I pushed a sanitized sample usage CSV to the SFDC case and shared with Ravi.

ravi_csm: @tyler_eng will you own the technical pre-check (model/latency feasibility)? If yes I'll assign and include in the kickoff.

tyler_eng: I can take the pre-check. I'll run a quick perf sim today. If we need quantized model variants or burst buffers, I'll note that.

aj_cs: Renewal risk flag — sales noted price sensitivity. Their initial ask: enterprise-level SLAs but with pilot discounts. We'll want to lock in a path to dedicated pricing before renewal. Marking renewal_risk: medium-high. @ravi_csm please add to account health dashboard.

ravi_csm: Will do. Also capturing feedback request: please ask Atlas product team for 3 success metrics for the pilot (eg. avg latency < 350ms, accuracy on curated prompts, adoption of >40% of clinicians in 4 weeks).

maria_sales: They care about latency and auditability primarily.

dena_support: Creating the internal support ticket now: SUPPORT-4219. Summary: Atlas Health SSO + dedicated capacity readiness. Blockers: SAML metadata, network CIDR for private deploy, legal confirmation on DPA. ETA for triage start: 24 hours.

ops-bot: Deploy alert — last hosted runtime deploy completed 12h ago (build 202-rev3). No active incidents.

tyler_eng: Quick sample SAML snippet request (paste into ticket):

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://atlas-idp.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

ravi_csm: Owner matrix so far:
- Ravi (CS): kickoff + account health dashboard + renewals flags
- Tyler (Eng): perf pre-check + dedicated config
- Dena (Support): support ticket + SSO triage
- Maria (Sales): SFDC docs + customer contacts

Please react with :thumbsup: if ok or add corrections.

aj_cs: :thumbsup:

maria_sales: :thumbsup:

dena_support: :thumbsup:

tyler_eng: :thumbsup:

ravi_csm: Next steps: creating meeting invite for tomorrow, I'll paste notes and attach SUPPORT-4219 and SFDC link. Expecting follow-up in this thread with ENG pre-check results and any legal items. Also scheduling a 30-min architecture sync after initial kickoff.

maria_sales: Thanks team. One more note — customer asked about early access to token-level cost breakdown during pilot. @ravi_csm can we enable cost dashboards for them temporarily?

ravi_csm: Yes — will request the enablement from Product Ops and include in kickoff. If we need a lower friction view we'll share a read-only dashboard link.

tyler_eng: If they need low-latency fallback for spikes we can configure autoscale burst, but that affects cost. I'll quantify impact in pre-check.

ravi_csm: Closing the loop here — will post meeting notes after kickoff and convert action items into the account plan. Thanks all.

maria_sales: Thanks, appreciate the quick turn.
